Stable SDL3-CS release for SDL 3.4.18 and SDL_image 3.4.8.

## Package Versions

| Package family | Version |
|----------------|---------|
| `SDL3-CS` | `3.4.18.1` |
| `SDL3-CS.<Platform>` | `3.4.18.1` |
| `SDL3-CS.<Platform>.Image` | `3.4.8.0` |
| `SDL3-CS.<Platform>.Mixer` | `3.2.4.14` |
| `SDL3-CS.<Platform>.TTF` | `3.2.2.14` |
| `SDL3-CS.<Platform>.Shadercross` | `3.0.0.14` |

## Changes

- Updated every Image native package to exact upstream SDL_image `release-3.4.8` ([#319](https://github.com/edwardgushchin/SDL3-CS/issues/319)).
- The upstream public header changes only its micro version macro; the managed SDL3-CS API and ABI are unchanged.
- Corrected the `SDL_SetGPUBlendConstants` interop ABI so `SDL_FColor` is passed by value, preserving constant blend colors ([#321](https://github.com/edwardgushchin/SDL3-CS/pull/321)).
- Corrected native IO read/write return values to use pointer-sized `size_t` values while preserving the public `ulong` API ([#318](https://github.com/edwardgushchin/SDL3-CS/pull/318)).
- Rebuilt the complete native RID matrix from the pinned sources; Mixer, TTF, and Shadercross use revision 14 because revision 13 was already published.

Applications should update `SDL3-CS` and the matching core platform package to `3.4.18.1`, then use the matching Image package version above.
## Stable API compatibility

The wrapper API and event layouts target stable SDL 3.4.18. Development-only SDL 3.6 APIs from PR #309 (including OpenXR, notifications and HasSVE2) are excluded from this release and from main until their native stable baseline is available. The IO size_t and GPU blend-constant ABI fixes are retained. The development changes remain available in Git history.

Stable upstream releases were rechecked on 2026-10-21: SDL 3.4.18, SDL_image 3.4.8, SDL_ttf 3.2.2 and SDL_mixer 3.2.4. SDL_shadercross has no stable release or SemVer tag, so its verified source pin is unchanged. All five component families are included in the full native release.
